fixtures.basis: SI identity conversion; one gram is one catalog gram.
SI identity conversion; one milliliter is one catalog milliliter.
One piece is one USDA Grade A large whole egg; FDC 748967 reports 50.3 g without shell.
FDC 2710168 reports 14 g per tablespoon; the NIST convention defines one tablespoon as three 5 mL teaspoons.
NIST metric-kitchen tablespoon definition; FDC 171413 independently reports 13.5 g per tablespoon for olive oil.
FDC 168935 reports 158 g for one cup cooked long-grain white rice.
Application-controlled serving definition: glass means 250 mL, displayed as such; it is not a universal household-glass claim.
Application-controlled katori equals the 124 g reference serving in FDC 2707430, one-half of its reported 248 g cup.
FDC 2707430 reports 248 g per cup and 124 g per reference serving; one cup equals two controlled katori servings.
